title: Compact pipeline log progress updates
summary: Compacts repeated pipeline progress log lines in WebView log displays and refreshes standalone log views every 2 seconds.
reason: The pipeline log panel could visually flood with repeated progress lines such as ENCODE : 65%, making the useful log context hard to scan during active work.
behavior_before: Diagnostics, floating overlay, and detached pipeline-log views rendered repeated progress-percent lines one-for-one.
behavior_after: Repeated adjacent progress-percent lines for the same route and percent render once with a collapsed update count; raw backend diagnostics payloads and log files remain unchanged.
